# Changelog

The changelog lives with the releases, not in this file — keeping both means keeping them in sync,
and the one that drifts is always this one.

**→ [Releases](https://github.com/mega-yfue/eufy-sdk/releases)**

Each release's notes describe what changed in that version. The project follows
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html); pre-1.0, a minor bump may still break.
